standard_prerequisites: The category WAdm^{Noeth} of adic Noetherian topological rings with continuous morphisms, as used in the source section on rig-etale homomorphisms
The completed naive cotangent complex NL with its functorial exact sequence, as developed earlier in the same chapter
Formal Spaces: the local-property criterion for properties of arrows of WAdm^{Noeth} (the variant-Noetherian remark), and completion of etale maps staying in the category
core_obligations: Preliminary vanishing: for etale A to A' and B to B' the completed complexes NL of the completions are zero, and the completed cotangent complex of B' over A' is the base change of the completed cotangent complex of B over A
Condition (1): rig-etale phi implies rig-etale phi' by base change of the annihilation bound on the cohomology
Condition (2): faithful flatness of B to B' descends the annihilation bound back to NL of B over A, giving rig-etale phi
Condition (3): finiteness under finite products, because NL of a product is the direct sum of the complexes
proof_roadmap: Set up the commutative square of adic Noetherian rings with etale A to A' and B to B', and note the completions again lie in the category
Derive the two quasi-isomorphisms (vanishing for etale maps; exact sequence of NL applied twice) and conclude NL_{(B')^/A'} is the base change of NL_{B/A}
Prove (1) by transporting the annihilation exponent c under base change
Prove (2) by faithful flatness descent of the annihilation, and (3) by the additivity of NL under finite products
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is that rig-etale is a local property of arrows in WAdm^{Noeth} (source lines 4787-4897, label lemma-rig-etale-axioms). The solver must first assemble the base-change identification of the completed naive cotangent complexes from two quasi-isomorphisms, then transport an annihilation bound forward under base change and backward under faithful flatness; the descent direction is the substantive step. Allowed background: the chapter's completed NL machinery and the formal-spaces lemmas cited, delivered as navigation pointers.
